name: Skeleton Quest II: Aye! Aye! Capt'n Rugal
summary: A Pirate Story: Join us for a sail. It’s one as old as time. It yearns and winds. The wind rises. Sirens sing. Ocean bells. Waves and rings. The pirate captain, Rugal Kid L., is hiring a crew to search for a new island. You, a young tavern kid, must find some way to pay for your entry. You can choose somewhere around town to obtain enough gold for your ration and board.
